resources.string: When Android hides the channel of the car hotspot, reads it from the firmware\'s hotspot configuration and also tells the iPhone the BSSID of the hotspot. Requires root (Magisk). Applies at the next connection.
Disconnect iPhone Bluetooth during wireless CarPlay (experimental)

Once wireless CarPlay starts, disconnects the Bluetooth calls, music, contacts and media controls of the iPhone from the head unit, as the car\'s own CarPlay does. For firmware that pauses CarPlay music over Bluetooth. CarPlay keeps running over Wi-Fi; the iPhone does not reconnect Bluetooth by itself afterwards. With several paired iPhones, choose yours in DiPlay: with its Bluetooth disconnected, DiPlay cannot pick it on its own next time. Requires root (Magisk). Applies at the next connection.
Let CarPlay audio through the car firewall (experimental)

While wireless CarPlay runs on the car hotspot, adds a firewall rule that accepts UDP from the iPhone on the hotspot and removes it when the session ends. For firmware whose firewall cuts CarPlay sound after a few seconds. Requires root (Magisk). Applies at the next connection.

The recorder input DiPlay uses for CarPlay calls and Siri. Auto keeps DiPlay\'s own choice. Try another input if the other party or Siri cannot hear you. The voice assistant bus records from the head unit\'s bus14_vr_in input and uses Auto where there is none. All cabin microphones records every channel of the microphone input and mixes them, so passengers in the back are heard too, and uses Auto where the head unit refuses. Applies from the next call or Siri request, without reconnecting.
Show CarPlay music on the dashboard and media widgets (experimental)

Shows the CarPlay track, artist, album and cover in the music widget of the stock instrument cluster and in the music widgets of the driver and passenger screens, and clears them when CarPlay ends. The widget buttons control CarPlay. Uses root (Magisk) only if the head unit refuses DiPlay\'s own request. Applies at once.
